<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?import javafx.geometry.Insets?> <?import javafx.scene.control.Button?> <?import javafx.scene.control.Label?> <?import javafx.scene.control.ScrollPane?> <?import javafx.scene.control.TableColumn?> <?import javafx.scene.control.TableView?> <?import javafx.scene.control.TextField?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.HBox?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.VBox?>
<ScrollPane xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml" fx:controller="view.MainController" fitToWidth="true" hbarPolicy="NEVER" vbarPolicy="AS_NEEDED" styleClass="page-scroll">
<VBox spacing="18" styleClass="page"> <padding> <Insets top="22" right="22" bottom="22" left="22"/> </padding>
<VBox spacing="6" styleClass="header-card"> <Label text="SJF vs Priority CPU Scheduling" styleClass="main-title"/> <Label text="JavaFX interface for comparing scheduling algorithms" styleClass="subtitle"/> </VBox>
<VBox spacing="14" styleClass="card"> <Label text="1. Add Process" styleClass="section-title"/>
<HBox spacing="12"> <TextField fx:id="pidField" promptText="PID e.g. P1" prefWidth="150"/> <TextField fx:id="arrivalField" promptText="Arrival Time" prefWidth="150"/> <TextField fx:id="burstField" promptText="Burst Time" prefWidth="150"/> <TextField fx:id="priorityField" promptText="Priority" prefWidth="150"/>
<Button text="Add Process" onAction="#addProcess" styleClass="primary-button"/> <Button text="Run Comparison" onAction="#runComparison" styleClass="success-button"/> <Button text="Clear All" onAction="#clearAll" styleClass="secondary-button"/> </HBox>
<Label fx:id="statusLabel" text="Ready." styleClass="status-label"/>
<TableView fx:id="inputTable" prefHeight="180"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="inputPidCol" text="PID" prefWidth="150"/> <TableColumn fx:id="inputArrivalCol" text="Arrival" prefWidth="150"/> <TableColumn fx:id="inputBurstCol" text="Burst" prefWidth="150"/> <TableColumn fx:id="inputPriorityCol" text="Priority" prefWidth="150"/> </columns> </TableView> </VBox>
<VBox spacing="14" styleClass="card"> <Label text="2. SJF Result" styleClass="section-title"/>
<HBox spacing="12"> <VBox styleClass="small-card"> <Label text="Average Waiting Time" styleClass="metric-title"/> <Label fx:id="sjfAvgWaitingLabel" text="-" styleClass="metric-value"/> </VBox>
<VBox styleClass="small-card"> <Label text="Average Turnaround Time" styleClass="metric-title"/> <Label fx:id="sjfAvgTurnaroundLabel" text="-" styleClass="metric-value"/> </VBox>
<VBox styleClass="small-card"> <Label text="Average Response Time" styleClass="metric-title"/> <Label fx:id="sjfAvgResponseLabel" text="-" styleClass="metric-value"/> </VBox> </HBox>
<TableView fx:id="sjfTable" prefHeight="230"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfPidCol" text="PID" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfArrivalCol" text="Arrival" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfBurstCol" text="Burst" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfPriorityCol" text="Priority" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfStartCol" text="Start" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfEndCol" text="End" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfWaitingCol" text="Waiting" prefWidth="100"/> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfTurnaroundCol" text="Turnaround" prefWidth="120"/> <TableColumn fx:id="sjfResponseCol" text="Response" prefWidth="110"/> </columns> </TableView>
<Label text="SJF Timeline" styleClass="mini-title"/> <HBox fx:id="sjfTimelineBox" spacing="8" styleClass="timeline-box"/> </VBox>
<VBox spacing="14" styleClass="card"> <Label text="3. Priority Result" styleClass="section-title"/>
<HBox spacing="12"> <VBox styleClass="small-card"> <Label text="Average Waiting Time" styleClass="metric-title"/> <Label fx:id="priorityAvgWaitingLabel" text="-" styleClass="metric-value"/> </VBox>
<VBox styleClass="small-card"> <Label text="Average Turnaround Time" styleClass="metric-title"/> <Label fx:id="priorityAvgTurnaroundLabel" text="-" styleClass="metric-value"/> </VBox>
<VBox styleClass="small-card"> <Label text="Average Response Time" styleClass="metric-title"/> <Label fx:id="priorityAvgResponseLabel" text="-" styleClass="metric-value"/> </VBox> </HBox>
<TableView fx:id="priorityTable" prefHeight="230"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityPidCol" text="PID" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityArrivalCol" text="Arrival" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityBurstCol" text="Burst" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityPriorityCol" text="Priority" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityStartCol" text="Start" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityEndCol" text="End" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityWaitingCol" text="Waiting" prefWidth="100"/> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityTurnaroundCol" text="Turnaround" prefWidth="120"/> <TableColumn fx:id="priorityResponseCol" text="Response" prefWidth="110"/> </columns> </TableView>
<Label text="Priority Timeline" styleClass="mini-title"/> <HBox fx:id="priorityTimelineBox" spacing="8" styleClass="timeline-box"/> </VBox>
<VBox spacing="14" styleClass="card"> <Label text="4. Conclusion" styleClass="section-title"/>
<HBox spacing="12"> <Button text="Winner in Total" onAction="#showTotalWinner" styleClass="primary-button"/> <Button text="Winner in WT" onAction="#showWaitingWinner" styleClass="secondary-button"/> <Button text="Winner in TAT" onAction="#showTurnaroundWinner" styleClass="secondary-button"/> <Button text="Winner in RT" onAction="#showResponseWinner" styleClass="secondary-button"/> </HBox>
<Label fx:id="conclusionLabel" text="Run the comparison first, then choose a winner button." wrapText="true" styleClass="compare-label"/> </VBox>
</VBox> </ScrollPane>
